title: Unique 3-Digit Even Numbers
summary: Given an array of digits, calculate the count of unique three-digit even numbers that can be formed without repeating any digit within a number and ensuring no leading zeros.
statement: Given an array of digits, calculate the count of unique three-digit even numbers that can be formed without repeating any digit within a number and ensuring no leading zeros.
constraints: Choose three distinct input positions to form a number.
The hundreds digit cannot be zero and the units digit must be even.
Return the count of distinct three-digit even values obtainable.
hints: Enumerate ordered triples of distinct positions.
Reject zero in the hundreds position and odd units digits.
Insert each valid numeric value into a set.
The set removes duplicates caused by equal digits at different positions.
editorial: The set removes duplicates caused by equal digits at different positions.

tests.explanation: Twelve distinct three-digit even numbers can be formed.
Only 202 and 220 can be formed from the available positions.
